title: Backpack with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Straps behind backpack -->
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='9' height='35' rx='4' fill='#7a1f1f'/>
  <rect x='69' y='18' width='9' height='35' rx='4' fill='#7a1f1f'/>
  <!-- Main backpack body -->
  <rect x='16' y='30' width='68' height='55' rx='14' fill='#e85d2a'/>
  <!-- Lighter body highlight -->
  <rect x='20' y='34' width='60' height='47' rx='11' fill='#f27a45'/>
  <!-- Front pocket -->
  <rect x='27' y='58' width='46' height='26' rx='9' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- Pocket highlight -->
  <rect x='31' y='61' width='38' height='20' rx='7' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <!-- Top handle -->
  <path d='M42 30 Q42 18 50 18 Q58 18 58 30' fill='none' stroke='#c94a1a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Zipper line on main body -->
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='60' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <!-- Zipper pull -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <!-- Buckle details on straps -->
  <rect x='21' y='42' width='11' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <rect x='68' y='42' width='11' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on pocket -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='68' r='4' fill='#333366'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='68' r='4' fill='#333366'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='67' r='1.5' fill='#aaaaee'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='67' r='1.5' fill='#aaaaee'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M38 75 Q50 85 62 75' fill='none' stroke='#333366' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='74' r='4' fill='#ff6666' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='74' r='4' fill='#ff6666' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
